units.rawText: An old friend here? You mean Simo? Ah... Perhaps friend is not the correct word, but I would be grateful if you were to arrange for me to work with him further…

units.rawText: Cough, I desire power and admire those who are strong. To want to work alongside the legendary Gaul makes sense, no?

units.rawText: ...In truth, perhaps I am simply clawing at the shadows of the past that cling onto him. Both of our pasts... are whited out.

units.rawText: Regardless, it is you that granted us what we hold in our hands and can look to in the future. I shall answer that with nothing less than utmost loyalty, Professor.
